info.name: Point Flow Backend API
info.description: Postman collection for the Point Flow backend REST API. Import this file, set `base_url`, run Bootstrap Admin or Login, then reuse `access_token` for protected endpoints. API responses use a standard envelope: `data`, `meta`, `error`, and `request_id`. Refresh tokens are stored as backend-generated HttpOnly cookies. Includes current auth, RBAC, cash register sessions, cash drawer movements, sales, sale returns, audit logs, inventory, procurement, payroll, reports, and dashboard analytics endpoints (sales trend, top products, hourly sales, low stock, sales by category, product scatter, cashier performance, procurement funnel). Also covers members, storefront member auth, online orders (staff + public storefront), finances, and profit sharing (SHU) endpoints.

request.description: Multipart gambar (field pertama, maks 2 MB). Permission `master_data`.

item.name: Members
item.description: Member master data. Deleting a member with transactions only deactivates it (soft delete).

item.name: Member Auth
item.description: Storefront member sessions. Login/refresh/logout are public (refresh uses the HttpOnly `member_refresh_token` cookie, handled by Postman's cookie jar). Authenticated calls use the separate `member_access_token` variable so staff and member tokens never mix.

item.name: Online Orders
item.description: Staff order pipeline (permission `online_orders`): new -> packing -> ready -> delivering -> completed. Includes store settings used by the storefront.

request.description: Multipart gambar QRIS (field pertama, maks 2 MB). Tampil di /public/store-info. Permission `online_orders`.

formdata.description: Pilih file gambar di Postman (diambil field pertama). Maks 2 MB, harus ada content-type image.

item.name: Public Storefront
item.description: Unauthenticated storefront endpoints (rate limited per IP). Member checkout sends the member JWT explicitly; the guest checkout must NOT send any Authorization header (a staff token would be rejected with 401).

request.description: Identity is taken from the member profile; member_id comes from the token, never the body.

item.name: Finances
item.description: Financial categories, manual transactions, and derivative reports (permission `finances`).

item.name: Profit Sharing
item.description: SHU period lifecycle (permission `profit_sharing`, admin only): draft -> calculate -> finalized, or cancel with a reason. Calculates from the income statement; snapshots per-member distributions.
